<!-- Parameters -->

```{r setup1, include = FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load(Rnssp, tidyverse, ggplot2, gt, flextable, MMWRweek, janitor, patchwork, cowplot, scales)

# Dates
start_date <- params$start_date # Start date of reporting period for APIs
end_date <- params$end_date # End date of reporting period for APIs

end_date_neat <- format(params$end_date, "%b %d, %Y")  #re-format date for readability
start_date_neat <- format(start_date, "%b %d, %Y") 

# Data source

if(params$data_source == "Facility Location"){
  data_source = "&datasource=va_hosp&geographySystem=hospitalregion"
} else{
  data_source = "&datasource=va_er&geographySystem=region"
}

# Section Exclusions
include_drown <- !("Drowning ED" %in% params$exclude_section)
include_boat <- !("Boating ED" %in% params$exclude_section)
include_smoke <- !("Smoke ED" %in% params$exclude_section)
include_asthma <- !("Asthma ED" %in% params$exclude_section)

```

```{r setup2, include=FALSE}

#Load in myProfile for API pulls
load("~/myProfileNSSP.Rda")
myProfile <- myProfileNSSP

# Source the functions file -- should be updated for this version
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sara-chronister/synchron/refs/heads/main/R/get_longterm_data.R")
source("autotemplate_functions_LHJ.R")

# Read in geography crosswalk 
geogdf <- read.csv("Support Resources/WA_Geo_API_Crosswalk.csv")

geogdfnew <- geogdf %>%
  select(-EMS, -CDC_Facility_HSA, -CDC_Patient_HSA, -PHEPR) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(County = paste("County - ",County, sep = ""),
         State = paste("State - ",State, sep = ""),
         StateRegion = paste("State Region - ",StateRegion, sep = ""),
         ACH = paste("ACH - ",ACH, sep = ""),
         RMO = paste("RMO - ",RMO, sep = ""),
         LHJ = paste("LHJ - ",LHJ, sep = "")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!APIsyntax, names_to = "Level", values_to ="Geography") %>%
  dplyr::select(!Level) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Geography==params$geog)

api_geog <- paste0(geogdfnew$APIsyntax, collapse = "")

geog_name <- params$geog # clean up a bit

# Read in Weather Station crosswalk
weather <- read.csv("Support Resources/Weather_Station_API_Crosswalk.csv")
weatherdf <- weather %>%
  dplyr::mutate(County = paste("County - ",County, sep = ""),
         State = paste("State - ",State, sep = ""),
         StateRegion = paste("State Region - ",StateRegion, sep = ""),
         ACH = paste("ACH - ",ACH, sep = ""),
         RMO = paste("RMO - ",RMO, sep = ""),
         LHJ = paste("LHJ - ",LHJ, sep = ""),
         All_Geo = "All (May include patients outside WA)") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!c("APIsyntax", "Station"), names_to = "Level", values_to ="Geography") %>%
  dplyr::select(!Level) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Geography==params$geog)

api_weather <- paste0(weatherdf$APIsyntax, collapse = "")

```


<!-- Pull Weather Data -->

```{r weather, results ='hide'}
# Weather data API pull - Time Series

# Only pull the weather data if the selected geography actually has weather data in ESSENCE
if(nrow(weatherdf) > 0){

weather_ts <- paste0("https://essence2.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/timeSeries?percentParam=noPercent&endDate=7Jul2023&userId=5695&weatherFactor=maxtemp&datasource=va_weather_aggr&stationAggregateFunc=max&timeResolution=daily&aqtTarget=TimeSeries&detector=probrepswitch&timeAggregateFunc=max&startDate=6May2023", api_weather)

ts_weather <- Rnssp::get_essence_data(weather_ts, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)

ts_weather <- ts_weather %>%
  dplyr::rename(temp = count) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# Replace 0 with NA in the last row only
ts_weather[nrow(ts_weather), "temp" ][ts_weather[nrow(ts_weather), "temp" ] == 0] <- NA

}

```

```{r airquality, results ='hide'}

# Air Quality Data - Pull in a list of all WA stations. 
url <- "https://essence2.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/dataDetails/csv?percentParam=noPercent&endDate=01Dec2023&airQualityParameterName=pm2.5-24hr&userId=1983&graphTitle=WA_Daily%20Max%20PM2.5&datasource=airquality&State=wa&stationAggregateFunc=max&timeResolution=daily&aqtTarget=TimeSeries&detector=probrepswitch&timeAggregateFunc=max&startDate=01May23"
airqualityOG <- get_essence_data(url, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)

airqualityOG2 <- airqualityOG %>%
  mutate(APIsyntax= paste0("&airQualityStation=", Station),
         County = gsub("; WA", "", County),
         County = str_to_title(County))

geogdfaq <- geogdf %>%
  select(County, State, StateRegion,  ACH, RMO, LHJ, PHEPR) %>%
  distinct()

airquality <- left_join(airqualityOG2, geogdfaq, by = "County")

airqualitydf <- airquality %>%
  dplyr::mutate(County = paste("County - ",County, sep = ""),
                State = paste("State - ",State, sep = ""),
                StateRegion = paste("State Region - ",StateRegion, sep = ""),
                ACH = paste("ACH - ",ACH, sep = ""),
                RMO = paste("RMO - ",RMO, sep = ""),
                LHJ = paste("LHJ - ",LHJ, sep = ""),
                All_Geo = "All (May include patients outside WA)",
                Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")) %>%
  select(Date, Station, Value, County, State, StateRegion, APIsyntax, ACH, RMO, LHJ, PHEPR, All_Geo) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!c("APIsyntax", "Station", "Date", "Value"), names_to = "Level", values_to ="Geography") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Geography==params$geog)

if(nrow(airqualitydf) > 0){
# keep max PM2.5 value each day for selected geography
ts_airquality <- airqualitydf %>%
  arrange(Date, Geography, desc(Value)) %>%
  distinct(Date, Geography, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(date = Date,  aq = Value)

# Replace 0 with NA in the last row only
ts_airquality[nrow(ts_airquality), "aq" ][ts_airquality[nrow(ts_airquality), "aq" ] == 0] <- NA
}


```

<!-- Pull Data Details -->

```{r denomdatadetails}

#ESSENCE data details fields to include
fields_list <-  list("Date","Sex", "AgeGroup",  "c_ethnicity","c_race", "Region", "HospitalRegion", "CCDDCategory_flat")

# Add &field= before each field
field <- paste(paste0("&field=",fields_list), collapse="")


dd_allcause <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/dataDetails?startDate=16Dec2025&medicalGroupingSystem=essencesyndromes&userId=5695&endDate=18Dec2025&percentParam=noPercent&site=934&hospFacilityType=emergency%20care&aqtTarget=DataDetails&detector=probrepswitch&timeResolution=daily&hasBeenE=1&refValues=true", data_source, api_geog, field)

dd_denom <- get_longterm_data(dd_allcause, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date ) #if errors out, try get_essence_data

```

```{r numdatadetails}

# Pull out all the condition-specific data details numerator data by CCDDCategory_flat
    # If there are no visits for one of the CCDD categories, will return data frame with zero rows
hri <- dd_denom %>%
  filter(grepl("Heat Related Illness v2", CCDDCategory_flat))

asthma <- dd_denom %>%
  filter(grepl("Severe Asthma v1", CCDDCategory_flat))

boat <- dd_denom %>%
  filter(grepl("Recreational Boating Incidents v1", CCDDCategory_flat))

drown <- dd_denom %>%
  filter(grepl("CDC Unintentional Drowning v1", CCDDCategory_flat))

# Smoke - pull own API (custom definition, DD only)

smoke_url <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/dataDetails?startDate=1May2025&medicalGroupingSystem=essencesyndromes&userId=5695&endDate=31Oct2025&percentParam=noPercent&hospFacilityType=emergency%20care&aqtTarget=DataDetails&detector=nodetectordetector&timeResolution=daily&hasBeenE=1&dischargeDiagnosis=%5E;J70.5%5E,or,%5E;J705%5E,or,%5E;T59.81%5E,or,%5E;T5981%5E,or,%5E;X01.1%5E,or,%5E;X011%5E,or,%5E;X08.8%5E,or,%5E;X088%5E&refValues=true&site=934", data_source, api_geog, field)

smoke <- get_essence_data(smoke_url, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date )
 # If there are no visits for smoke, will return empty list-- convert to empty data frame or later lines will error out
if (is.list(smoke) && !inherits(smoke, "data.frame")) {
  smoke <- as.data.frame(smoke)
}

```

```{r}

# Pull time series data - CCDDS

timeseries_url <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/timeSeries?startDate=23Sep25&medicalGroupingSystem=essencesyndromes&userId=5695&endDate=22Dec25&percentParam=ccddCategory&site=934&hospFacilityType=emergency%20care&aqtTarget=TimeSeries&ccddCategory=cdc%20unintentional%20drowning%20v1&ccddCategory=heat%20related%20illness%20v2&ccddCategory=severe%20asthma%20v1&ccddCategory=recreational%20boating%20incidents%20v1&detector=probrepswitch&timeResolution=daily&hasBeenE=1&stratVal=ccddCategory&multiStratVal=&graphOnly=true&numSeries=4&graphOptions=single&seriesPerYear=false&nonZeroComposite=false&removeZeroSeries=true&startMonth=January&stratVal=ccddCategory&multiStratVal=&graphOnly=true&numSeries=4&graphOptions=single&seriesPerYear=false&startMonth=January&nonZeroComposite=false", data_source, api_geog)


all_timeseries <- Rnssp::get_essence_data(timeseries_url, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)
all_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  select(date,
         Percent = count, 
         alert_percent = color,
         Count = dataCount,
         alert_count = color_dataCount,
         Category = ccddCategory_id) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  ## NEW
  mutate(alert_percent = ifelse(alert_percent == "grey", "blue", alert_percent),
         alert_count = ifelse(alert_count == "grey", "blue", alert_count))

# Subset CCDD category time series
# If there are no visits for one of the CCDD categories, will return data frame with zero rows

hri_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  filter(Category == "Heat Related Illness v2")

boat_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  filter(Category == "Recreational Boating Incidents v1")

asthma_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  filter(Category == "Severe Asthma v1")

drown_timeseries <- all_timeseries %>%
  filter(Category == "CDC Unintentional Drowning v1")

#Smoke
# If there are no visits for smoke -- will still return a dataframe with a row for every day in your pull, just counts/percents will be zero!

# Time series smoke -- percent
smoke_timeseries_percent_url <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/timeSeries?startDate=1May2025&medicalGroupingSystem=essencesyndromes&userId=5695&endDate=31Oct2025&percentParam=dischargeDiagnosis&site=934&hospFacilityType=emergency%20care&aqtTarget=TimeSeries&detector=probrepswitch&timeResolution=daily&hasBeenE=1&dischargeDiagnosis=%5E;J70.5%5E,or,%5E;J705%5E,or,%5E;T59.81%5E,or,%5E;T5981%5E,or,%5E;X01.1%5E,or,%5E;X011%5E,or,%5E;X08.8%5E,or,%5E;X088%5E", data_source, api_geog)

smoke_timeseries_percent <- Rnssp::get_essence_data(smoke_timeseries_percent_url, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)

smoke_timeseries_percent <- smoke_timeseries_percent %>%
  select(date,
         Percent = count, 
         alert_percent = color) %>%
  mutate(Category = "Falls",
         date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  ## NEW
  mutate(alert_percent = ifelse(alert_percent == "grey", "blue", alert_percent))

# Time series smoke -- count
# Must pull count separately because percent pull does not include dataCount columns for some reason

smoke_timeseries_count_url <- paste0("https://essence.syndromicsurveillance.org/nssp_essence/api/timeSeries?startDate=1May2025&medicalGroupingSystem=essencesyndromes&userId=5695&endDate=31Oct2025&percentParam=noPercent&site=934&hospFacilityType=emergency%20care&aqtTarget=TimeSeries&detector=probrepswitch&timeResolution=daily&hasBeenE=1&dischargeDiagnosis=%5E;J70.5%5E,or,%5E;J705%5E,or,%5E;T59.81%5E,or,%5E;T5981%5E,or,%5E;X01.1%5E,or,%5E;X011%5E,or,%5E;X08.8%5E,or,%5E;X088%5E", data_source, api_geog)

smoke_timeseries_count <- Rnssp::get_essence_data(smoke_timeseries_count_url, start_date = start_date, end_date = end_date)
smoke_timeseries_count <- smoke_timeseries_count %>%
  select(date,
         Count = count, 
         alert_count = color) %>%
  mutate(Category = "Falls",
         date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  ## NEW
  mutate(alert_count = ifelse(alert_count == "grey", "blue", alert_count))


```

<!-- Summary Calculations -->

```{r calcs}

# Total HRI visits in report period
hri_visitcount <- nrow(hri)

# Create the hri demographic table and pull summary metrics out from it
hri_table <- create_flextable(denomdf = dd_denom, numdf = hri, title = "HRI")

# Save the flextable object as a dataframe for manipulation
extracted_hri_table <- hri_table$body$dataset

hri_table2 <- extracted_hri_table[, 1:3]
hri_table2[c("Count", "Percent")] <- str_split_fixed(hri_table2[,3], " ", 2)
hri_table2$Count <- gsub(",",  "", hri_table2$Count ) # clean commas from count column, they don't play nice
hri_table2$Count <- as.numeric(hri_table2$Count) #make count numeric

max <- hri_table2 %>%
  group_by(Demographic) %>%              # Group by demographic field
  mutate(MaxCount = max(Count)) %>%    # Get max value in each group 
  filter(Count == MaxCount) %>%
  mutate(Percent = gsub("[()]", "", Percent))

agegroupmax <- max$Group[max$Demographic == "AgeGroup"]
ageprop <- unique(max$Percent[max$Demographic == "AgeGroup"])
sexmax <- max$Group[max$Demographic == "Sex"]
sexprop <- unique(max$Percent[max$Demographic == "Sex"])
racemax <- max$Group[max$Demographic == "Race"]
raceprop <- unique(max$Percent[max$Demographic == "Race"])
ethnicitymax <- max$Group[max$Demographic == "Ethnicity"]
ethnicityprop <- unique(max$Percent[max$Demographic == "Ethnicity"])

# Is hri alerting?
percent_elevated <- any(hri_timeseries$alert_percent %in% c( "red", "yellow") )
count_elevated <- any(hri_timeseries$alert_count %in% c( "red", "yellow") )
 
 if(percent_elevated == "TRUE" | count_elevated == "TRUE"){
   elevated <- "were elevated"
 } else{elevated <- "were not elevated"}

```

# `r if(params$geog != "All (May include patients outside WA)"){geog_name} else{"Washington State"}`
Summer hazards are defined as outdoor conditions, extreme weather events, or recreational activities and can cause various adverse health effects resulting in healthcare visits. This report contains weather data and analyses of healthcare encounter data for summer hazards, including suspected heat-related illness (HRI), asthma, smoke exposure related visits, drowning and submersion, and recreational boating-related emergency department (ED) visits based on data reported to the Rapid Health Information NetwOrk (RHINO).

# Key Findings: `r start_date_neat` to `r end_date_neat`

HRI ED visits `r elevated` on at least one day during the reporting period.[^1] There were a **total of `r hri_visitcount` HRI ED visits**. The **`r agegroupmax` age group** had the highest proportion of visits (`r ageprop`). `r sexprop` of visits were **`r tolower(sexmax)`** patients. Patients of **`r tolower(racemax)` race** (`r raceprop`) and **`r tolower(ethnicitymax)` ethnicity** (`r ethnicityprop`) accounted for the most visits.

[^1]: Daily visit counts are considered elevated if values exceed what was expected statistically. See Data Notes for additional information.

# Heat-Related Illness (HRI)

Extreme heat may lead to heat-related illness (HRI), particularly in those with chronic conditions, pregnant individuals, young children and older adults, and those who work or recreate outdoors. To reduce the risk of HRI, stay indoor in air conditioned spaces or plan outdoor activities during cooler times of the day, drink plenty of fluids, and take frequent breaks when working outdoors. 

## HRI ED Visits Over Time

```{r hri_plot, dpi=300, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.5, echo=FALSE}


p1 <- timeseries_plot_weather(df = hri_timeseries,  metric = "Percent", alert= "alert_percent",  title = "Heat-Related Percent ED Visits", ylab = "Visit Percent", weatherlab = "Max Temperature (F)", weatherfactor = "Temp") +
  theme(
      legend.position = "none", # no legend for first plot
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis title
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis text
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())  

p2 <- timeseries_plot_weather(df = hri_timeseries,  metric = "Count", alert= "alert_count",  title = "Heat-Related ED Visit Count", ylab = "Visit Count", weatherlab = "Max Temperature (F)", weatherfactor = "Temp") +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),  # Legend title font
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8)) 

#Combine with shared x-axis
(p1 / p2) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
  ) & 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) &
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(),
                            limits = c(min(hri_timeseries$date)-0.05, max(hri_timeseries$date)+0.1),
                            expand = c(0, 0))


```

```{r asthma_plot, dpi=300, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.0, echo=FALSE, eval = include_asthma, results = 'asis'}
cat("Outdoor air pollutants, indoor environmental contaminants, climate, exercise, colds and other respiratory infections, among other causes, can trigger or exacerbate asthma symptoms. \n\n")

cat("## Asthma-Related ED Visits Over Time\n\n")


p1 <- timeseries_plot_weather(df = asthma_timeseries,  metric = "Percent", alert= "alert_percent",  title = "Asthma-Related Percent ED Visits", ylab = "Visit Percent", weatherlab = "Max PM2.5 (ug/m^3)", weatherfactor = "AQ") +
  theme(
      legend.position = "none", # no legend for first plot
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis title
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis text
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) 
  

p2 <- timeseries_plot_weather(df = asthma_timeseries,  metric = "Count", alert= "alert_count",  title = "Asthma-Related ED Visit Count", ylab = "Visit Count", weatherlab = "Max PM2.5 (ug/m^3)", weatherfactor = "AQ") +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),  # Legend title font
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8)) 


#Combine with shared x-axis
(p1 / p2) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
  ) & 
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) &
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(),
                            limits = c(min(asthma_timeseries$date)-0.05, max(asthma_timeseries$date)+0.1),
                            expand = c(0, 0))
}
```

```{r asthma_table, eval = include_asthma, results = 'asis', echo=FALSE}

cat("## Populations Impacted\n\n")
cat(paste("Table 3. Demographics of asthma and all-cause ED visits", start_date_neat, "to", end_date_neat, ". \n\n", sep = " "))
  
asthmatable <- create_flextable(denomdf = dd_denom, numdf = asthma, title = "Asthma")
asthmatable

}
```

# Data Notes

This report contains analyses of healthcare encounter data for seasonal hazards based on data reported to the Washington State Deparatment of Health's Rapid Health Information NetwOrk (RHINO). All non-federal hospitals across Washington State report healthcare encounter data in near real-time to RHINO. Data are preliminary and may change. Data reflect unique healthcare visits, and do not represent unique individuals.

Air quality data is obtained from regulatory monitoring sites managed and collected by regional clean air agencies and the Washington State Department of Ecology and provided by AirNow. The maximum PM2.5 concentration (ug/m3) on that day is displayed. Temperature data is obtained from the CF6 dataset maintained by the National Weather Service. Data reflects the maximum temperature recorded each day.

Red and yellow points on time series correspond to values that exceed what was expected statistically (alerts), with red indicating larger deviations. Bolded demographic bins in tables represent groups with statistically significant differences between condition-specific and all-cause ED visit counts, as determined by chi-square test standardized pearson residuals (significance threshold: residuals > 3).

For additional seasonal hazards information including more county-specific information, please see the public-facing RHINO [Seasonal Hazards Dashboard](https://doh.wa.gov/public-health-provider-resources/healthcare-professions-and-facilities/data-exchange/syndromic-surveillance-rhino/seasonal-hazards-dashboard).

## Visit Definitions

*If one of the below conditions is not included in this report, then there were no visits identified.*

**Heat-related Illness:** Identified through the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, Heat-Related Illness V2, using free text terms such as “heat”, “sun stroke”, and “hyperthermia” and ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (including E900, T67, X30) among ED chief complaints and discharge diagnoses. For more info, see: [HRI Factsheet](https://knowledgerepository.syndromicsurveillance.org/sites/default/files/2024-07/Heat%20Related%20Illness%20v2.pdf).

**Boating-related:** Identified through the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, Recreational Boating Incidents v1, using free text terms such as “boat", "jet ski”, and ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (including V90-94, W16.7) among ED chief complaints and discharge diagnoses. For more info, see: [Recreational Boating Factsheet](https://cdn.ymaws.com/www.cste.org/resource/resmgr/images5/recreational_boating_inciden.pdf).

**Asthma:** Identified through the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, Severe Asthma v1, using free text terms such as "asthma attack" or "asthma exacerbation" or diagnosis codes related to acute asthma (J45) or acute bronchospasm (J98.01) among ED chief complaints and discharge diagnoses. For more info, see: [Severe Asthma Factsheet](https://knowledgerepository.syndromicsurveillance.org/sites/default/files/2025-07/Severe%20Asthma%20v1%20Factsheet.pdf).

**Smoke-Inhalation:** Custom query applied to discharge diagnosis field. Visits identified using ICD-10 codes (J70.5, T59.81, X01.1, X08.8).

**Drowning or submersion:** Identified through the CDC ESSENCE Chief Complaint Discharge Diagnosis (CCDD) query category, Unintentional Drowning V1, using free text terms such as “drown", "under water” and ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes (including T751, V90, V91, V92, W16, W22.041) among ED chief complaints and discharge diagnoses.
